# Oak & Linen

> Oak & Linen is an independent interior design studio in Portland, Oregon, founded in 2016. It designs homes and small offices in Portland, Beaverton, Lake Oswego, Hillsboro and Vancouver WA.

## Key facts
- Services: full-home design (from $4,800), single-room refresh (from $1,400), styling and furnishing (from $950), design consultation ($180).
- Free 20-minute consultation by WhatsApp, phone or web form. Replies within two working hours.
- Address: 128 Maple Street, Suite 4, Portland, OR 97205
- Phone / WhatsApp: +1 503 555 0142
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–6pm, Sat 10am–2pm (Pacific Time)
